newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EMV Q1 PROFIT 1.4 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: EMV Q1 PROFIT 1.4 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Estonia's largest construction company, EMV, said on Monday that its first quarter operating profit was 1.4 million kroons and that its turnover in the same period was 53 million kroons.
"First quarter results were according to plans and are moving towards estimated figures," the company said in a statement.
EMV has signed construction agreements worth 220 million kroons covering 77 percent of its estimated construction amount.
EMV's German subsidiary, EMV SystemBau GbmH, has signed its first contract for a building which is due to be ready in July in Rostock.
EMV Soilmec has signed a construction agreement with the Tallinn Water and Sewage Company worth 27 million kroons, the company added.
